shortDescription: NetApp Cloud Manager connector for GCP.

options.name: account_id
options.description: The NetApp account ID that the Connector will be associated with. If not provided, Cloud Manager uses the first account. If no account exists, Cloud Manager creates a new account. You can find the account ID in the account tab of Cloud Manager at [https://cloudmanager.netapp.com](https://cloudmanager.netapp.com).

options.name: associate_public_ip
options.description: Indicates whether to associate a public IP address to the virtual machine.

options.name: client_id
options.description: The client ID of the Cloud Manager Connector. The connector ID. If state is absent, the client id is used to identify the agent and delete it. If state is absent and this parameter is not set, all agents associated with C(name) are deleted. Ignored when state is present.

options.name: company
options.description: The name of the company of the user.

options.name: environment
options.description: The environment for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: feature_flags
options.description: Enable or disable a new feature. This can be used to enable an experimental feature or disable a new feature that breaks backward compatibility. Supported keys and values are subject to change without notice.  Unknown keys are ignored.

options.name: firewall_tags
options.description: Indicates whether to add firewall_tags to the connector VM (HTTP and HTTP).

options.name: gcp_service_account_email
options.description: The email of the service_account for the connector instance. This service account is used to allow the Connector to create Cloud Volume ONTAP.

options.name: gcp_service_account_path
options.description: The local path of the service_account JSON file for GCP authorization purposes. This service account is used to create the Connector in GCP.

options.name: machine_type
options.description: The machine_type for the Connector VM.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the Cloud Manager connector for GCP to manage.

options.name: network_project_id
options.description: The project id in GCP associated with the Subnet. If not provided, it is assumed that the Subnet is within the previously specified project id.

options.name: project_id
options.description: The GCP project_id where the connector will be created.

options.name: proxy_certificates
options.description: The proxy certificates. A list of certificate file names.

options.name: proxy_password
options.description: The proxy password, if using a proxy to connect to the internet.

options.name: proxy_url
options.description: The proxy URL, if using a proxy to connect to the internet.

options.name: proxy_user_name
options.description: The proxy user name, if using a proxy to connect to the internet.

options.name: refresh_token
options.description: The refresh token for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: sa_client_id
options.description: The service account secret client ID for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: sa_secret_key
options.description: The service account secret key for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified Cloud Manager connector for GCP should exist or not.

options.name: subnet_id
options.description: The name of the subnet for the virtual machine.

options.name: zone
options.description: The GCP zone where the Connector will be created.
